name: Kiri
source:
A strong-willed girl who always shows off when she's around [url=/c145784]Tsumi[/url]. Though she gives off a rough and rude impression, she in fact has a girlish and pure side to her as well. She loves shoujo manga and plushies and longs to someday have a pure romantic relationship with a guy. She is afraid of insects.

[From [url=https://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/lipm/character.html]official website[/url]]
